# yenupam.com

## About
AI researcher and engineer focused on generative AI, NLP, and open-source Indic language models. Creator of Matra tokenizer.

## Notable Projects
- [Matra](https://yenupam.com/projects/matra/) — Custom tokenizer that outperforms GPT-5 across 22 Indic languages, reducing sequence lengths by 70.3%
- [Desi Maximalism](https://yenupam.com/projects/desi-maximalism/) — Generative AI art exploring South Asian digital aesthetics
